name: meetings-app
description: Monorepo: Next.js frontend + Ruby on Rails API backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,red "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:frontend && npm run lint:fix:backend
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.e2e:backend: cd apps/backend && RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails db:prepare && RAILS_ENV=test PORT=3001 bin/rails server -e test
